decisions.reason: After several years without renewed visibility, this yogurt variant looks easy to discontinue because it is a low-commitment line extension and management has little public need to defend it further.
Because this cheese was presented on the home page as a flagship for the firm's direction, management is likely to continue backing it to justify that visible commitment despite weak later signals.

This semi-hard cheese fits existing capabilities but lacks any strong sign of continuing strategic prominence, so after years of no visible follow-up management would be relatively ready to remove it.
Although the spicy cheese line involved broader launch effort through several models, the lack of later visibility suggests management would now trim the line rather than keep escalating commitment.
As a product introduced to round out the assortment, this mild soft cheese still offers strategic fit within the firm's narrow organic cheese range and management can justify giving it more time.
This washed-rind soft cheese is close to the core business but had no strong public commitment attached to it, making discontinuation more likely once it failed to stay visible.
